195:t_018:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's the first step forward done.」

195:t_018:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shall we take a big stride next?」

195:t_018:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Using this base as a foothold, we attack the Imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

195:t_018:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Once the capital falls, the enemy's chain of command will be severed. After that, we just take them out one by one.」

195:t_018:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So the next battle will decide the fate of the Earth, huh.」

195:t_018:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's exactly why it was worth us joining up with you.」

195:t_018:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone. We're taking this Earth back from $$サイデリアル$$.」

195:t_019:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed the enemy force has been wiped out.」

195:t_019:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's the first step forward done.」

195:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shall we take a big stride next?」

195:t_019:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Using this base as a foothold, we attack the Imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

195:t_019:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Once the capital falls, the enemy's chain of command will be severed. After that, we just take them out one by one.」

195:t_019:5.en:

195:t_019:6.en:

「That's exactly why it was worth us joining up with you.」

195:t_019:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone. We're taking this Earth back from $$サイデリアル$$.」

195:t_020:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The transport ship is pulling out!」

195:t_020:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We will stop the remaining ships no matter what! Send the highly mobile units first!」

195:t_021:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy ship's engine is damaged! It's making an emergency landing!」

195:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Send in $$エコーズ$$! Rescue the citizens who were being held prisoner!」

195:t_022:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The last enemy ship has stopped!」

195:t_022:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「We did it! That's everyone rescued!」

195:t_022:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All that's left is to clear out the remaining enemy units. I'm counting on you.」

195:t_023:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「No way...! The people who were on board...」

195:t_023:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then this... was all for nothing...」

195:t_024:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-not good...! A blunder like this time's is really bad!」

195:t_024:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「At this rate, my position will...!」

195:t_025:0.en:
$n
「That guy... He always says something like that whenever he runs away...」

195:t_025:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even so, if they've left him in command like this, maybe he's actually competent after all.」

195:t_025:2.en:
$n
「If so, I think the Empire must be seriously short on talent.」

195:t_026:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Huh... That girl $$ノリコ$$ uses the same move as $$ノノ$$.」

195:t_026:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$ニコラ$$! $$ノノ$$'s Lightning Kick is way cooler!」

195:t_026:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Listen here! I won't forgive anyone who makes fun of Okinawa Girls' High's traditional Lightning Reversal Kick!」

195:t_026:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you two doing with the enemy right in front of us...」

195:t_027:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, bro. I got in your way.」

195:t_027:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Still, I'm just plain unlucky. I was hard at work collecting debts, and the Empire goes and nabs me...」

195:t_027:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Save the life story and get out of here already! It's dangerous here!」

195:t_027:4.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, bro. Take this to make up for the trouble! I swiped it from the Empire!」

195:t_028:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you sure!? This is a real treasure!」

195:t_028:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Don't worry about it! The greatest treasure is life, after all!」

195:t_028:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Great line! I like you, pal!」

195:t_028:3.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Likewise, nice guy! This is $$ゼニトリー・マッセ$$, and I'll keep on collecting honestly and righteously!」

195:t_029:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sorry, sis. I got in your way.」

195:t_029:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Still, I'm just plain unlucky. I was hard at work collecting debts, and the Empire goes and nabs me...」

195:t_029:3.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Sis... Want to hear my life story?」

195:t_029:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「M-maybe some other time, so please get to safety first!」

195:t_029:5.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Will do! Take this to make up for the trouble! I swiped it from the Empire!」

195:t_030:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Are you sure? This looks like a pretty expensive part...」

195:t_030:1.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「Don't worry about it! You saved my life!」

195:t_030:2.en:
$$ゼニトリー$$
「This is $$ゼニトリー・マッセ$$, and I'll keep on collecting honestly and righteously!」

195:t_030:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Bald people... They're all so full of vitality.)

195:t_031:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「A $$獣人$$ here, of all places!?」

195:t_031:2.en:
$$獣人$$
「It's been a long time, Captain $$ヴィラル$$! Man, I'm so glad to see you!」

195:t_031:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is no time to be so carefree! Get out of here, now!」

195:t_031:4.en:
$$獣人$$
「So you're $$シモン$$ of $$大グレン団$$!」

195:t_031:5.en:
$$獣人$$
「Yeah... You're the one who can make full use of my treasure.」

195:t_032:1.en:
$$獣人$$
「See ya! Don't lose to that guy, Digger $$シモン$$!」

195:t_032:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... It seems that guy has fought $$カミナ$$ and you as a kid.」

195:t_032:3.en:
$$シモン$$
(I'll do it, Bro...! I'll become a man who can live up to these sunglasses!)

195:t_100:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「War is pointless! Listen to my song!!」

195:t_100:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(That's right, $$バサラ$$. You just keep being you.)

195:t_100:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(War really is pointless. That's why we soldiers fight: to end the war as quickly as we can.)

195:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ランカ$$... What on earth happened to you...?)

195:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Damn...! Is this the time to worry about $$ミカゲ$$'s nightmares...!)

195:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis... Now that I've got $$ガンバスター$$ back, I'll fight with everything I have...)

195:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(My own fire, and the fire I inherited from Big Sis... I'll combine them into a flame!)

195:t_102:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't just stand there, $$ノノ$$! As long as you're riding $$ディスヌフ$$, you're going to work!」

195:t_102:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-yes! $$ノノ$$ will do her best together with Big Sis!」

195:t_102:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「With the hard work and guts $$ノノリリ$$ taught $$ノノ$$!」

195:t_103:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「We owe $$サイデリアル$$ a huge debt...!」

195:t_103:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Yeah...! We'll definitely take them down, for everyone waiting for us on the $$新世界大陸$$!」

195:t_103:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Today's just a skirmish before the decisive battle! Don't slip up, $$シモン$$!」
